extractions.description: An empirical mining-software-repositories study of self-admitted technical debt (SATD) in 318 open-source machine learning projects and 318 non-ML Python projects from GitHub. The authors extract code comments, detect SATD with an NLP-based SATD detector tool, manually classify a sample of 611 SATD comments into a taxonomy and into ML pipeline stages, perform Kaplan-Meier survival analysis of SATD introduction/removal, and build a Random Forest explanatory model (interpreted with SHAP) of long-lasting SATD.

type.quote: This paper aims to investigate the occurrence of SATD in ML code by analyzing 318 open-source ML projects across five domains, along with 318 non-ML projects.
type.justification: The study mines and analyses real project data empirically.
